decor._doc: Cosmetic dressing of the map made by tools/city/ciudad.py (vestir/generar), read only by WorldView (game/): the sim never reads it. kind house|yard|single: a filler lot (its tiles at..at+size); house: facing = the side of its door [dc, dr], flip = mirrored; lantern/prop/fence: one prop on tile `at`, off = pixel shift from the tile's centre. site: the item belongs to that map site (buildings of data/maps): a lot with site is the look of the site's footprint in a game without that building (drawn only then), a prop with site (a workshop's barrels) is drawn only with that building. Re-run the tool after editing rows or buildings.
